column2: The hand rests the coffee cup on the table; Hun pushes the tray of seven mood stones toward the hand. f02: Hun leans its whole body into the tray, tray moves a little toward the hand. f03: tray moves further. f04: tray reaches next to the hand; Hun stands upright, catching breath. f05: the hand's fingers relax and open a little toward the stones. f06: Hun looks up toward the hand. f07: Hun gives a small hopeful smile. f08: tiny settle (body a few pixels lower). Coffee steam changes shape every frame.

f02: the index finger moves closer to the fifth (peach) mood stone. f03: fingertip touches it; the stone starts to glow faintly. f04: glow brighter. f05: Hun's eyes widen a little. f06: Hun's smile grows, cheeks pinker, flippers still on its cheeks. f07: the coffee cup lifts a little higher. f08: tiny settle. Steam changes shape every frame.

The phone on the shelf vibrates. f02: phone shifted a few pixels left, two tiny clay motion marks beside it. f03: phone shifted right; Hun's head tuft stands up higher. f04: phone shifted left again. f05: phone still; Hun blinks. f06: Hun's eyes open, looking at the phone. f07: Hun leans forward. f08: Hun takes one small step toward the shelf (one foot forward).

f02: Hun leans into the pill organiser, it slides a little toward the hand. f03: slides further. f04: it reaches the hand. f05: the newspaper lowers a little. f06: the fingers reach toward the open compartment. f07: the fingers pick up a small pill. f08: Hun steps back a little, satisfied.

Hun hugs the small phone against its belly. f02: Hun nods (head tilts down). f03: head back up. f04: nods down again. f05: head up, small smile. f06: the heart icon on the blood-pressure monitor glows brighter. f07: the screen of the phone on the stand glows warmer. f08: Hun closes its eyes happily, hugging the phone a little tighter.

f02: the hand lowers the market basket closer to the table. f03: basket rests on the table, vegetables wobble slightly. f04: the hand lets go and moves toward the frame edge. f05: the hand is gone; the phone lights up with the speech-bubble shape. f06: Hun turns its head toward the phone. f07: Hun takes a step toward the phone. f08: Hun stands next to the phone, looking at it.

The speech-bubble shape floats from the phone to the notebook over the frames. f02: bubble just above the phone. f03: bubble halfway. f04: bubble above the notebook. f05: bubble shrinks and stretches into a line. f06: the line settles on the notebook page. f07: the coin next to the notebook glints. f08: Hun nods, pleased.

Hun lifts the big coin toward the jar slot by rising on tiptoe (flippers stay short, coin hugged to belly). f02: Hun on tiptoe, coin a little higher. f03: coin at the slot edge. f04: coin tilted into the slot. f05: coin half inside. f06: coin gone into the jar. f07: Hun squashes down happily, eyes closed. f08: Hun settles, smiling.

Tea pours from the teapot hugged against Hun's body. f02: thin tea stream starts into the nearest cup. f03: cup fills a little. f04: cup half full; a drop spills on the saucer. f05: spill grows a little. f06: Hun stops pouring, teapot upright. f07: Hun looks at the spill, embarrassed. f08: the hand in the sage cardigan sleeve slides a small clay napkin toward the spill.

f02: the child's finger moves toward the low column. f03: the finger touches the low column. f04: the dad's thumbs-up rises a little higher. f05: Hun crouches (squash) ready to hop. f06: Hun in the air a little above the table (small hop). f07: Hun lands, squashed. f08: Hun settles upright, smiling.

Hun, standing on a stool, crosses out the house slot on the board with its beak. f02: beak touches the house slot. f03: first diagonal stroke drawn halfway. f04: first stroke complete. f05: second stroke complete (an X). f06: Hun leans back to look. f07: Hun looks down toward the new pair of slippers by the door. f08: Hun tilts its head, curious.

Hun writes in the tiny diary on its lap with the stubby pencil held against its belly. f02: a small scribble mark appears (no letters). f03: a second scribble. f04: a third. f05: Hun pauses and looks up, thinking. f06: Hun looks back down. f07: another scribble. f08: Hun begins to close the diary.

f02: Hun lowers the diary toward the heart-padlock box. f03: diary inside the box. f04: lid half closed. f05: lid closed, padlock shut. f06: Hun turns toward the curtain cord. f07: Hun pulls the cord with its beak; the curtain moves a little. f08: curtain half drawn; the room a touch darker.

Hun sleeps; only tiny changes. f02: Hun's belly rises slightly (breath in). f03: belly lowers. f04: the bedside lamp a little dimmer. f05: belly rises. f06: one tiny clay fish in the jar shifts. f07: lamp dimmer still. f08: belly lowers; moonlight on the blanket a touch brighter.
